the use of a tuned algorithm version is strongly recommended in the Ionian Sea coastal waters, where the chl-a concentrations are generally low and the bio-optical characteristics are not typical of open oceanic areas.

the use of a semi-analytical algorithm is recommended for chl-a retrieval in this coastal area, while a locally tuned version of the MODISAqua OCx algorithm could be used in case of a lack of in situ measurements.

the use of local bio-optical parameters in semi-analytical models can improve the accuracy of MODIS chl a retrievals in the coastal areas.

a local scale tuning of the MODIS algorithms, based on in situ measurements, allows to obtain a better accuracy of the retrieved chl-a concentration.
the local scale tuning of the MODIS algorithm is a useful tool for improving the accuracy of the retrieved chl-a concentration.
